animal_messenger.name: Animal Messenger
animal_messenger.dicePool: None (Famulus tests when target location unknown)

linguistics__linguistics.name: Linguistics
linguistics__linguistics.description: Each dot allows the character to read, write, and speak fluently in another language beyond their native tongue and the Domain language. (Your character by defult only knows Modern Greek and English).

linguistics__illiterate.name: Illiterate
linguistics__illiterate.description: Cannot read or write. Academics and Science Skills cannot go beyond 1 dot.

looks__beautiful.name: Beautiful
looks__beautiful.description: Add +1 die to related Social pools.

looks__stunning.name: Stunning
looks__stunning.description: Add +2 dice to related Social pools.

looks__semblance_of_the_methuselah.name: Semblance of the Methuselah
looks__semblance_of_the_methuselah.description: A striking resemblance to a methuselah grants +1 die to impress/intimidate/attract those who recognize the face (plus situational bonuses at ST discretion). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Forbidden Religions, page 85)

looks__famous_face.name: Famous Face
looks__famous_face.description: Resemble someone famous: +2 dice in social tests where this helps; −2 dice to avoid recognition/hide in a crowd. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 118)

looks__ingénue.name: Ingénue
looks__ingénue.description: Appear innocent and blameless: +2 dice to avoid suspicion or deflect blame (ST discretion). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 118)

looks__remarkable_feature.name: Remarkable Feature
looks__remarkable_feature.description: Rare/memorable feature: +2 dice with strangers; −1 die to disguise. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 118)

looks__up_all_night.name: Up All Night
looks__up_all_night.description: Treat Humanity as +1 (max 10), or +2 at four dots, for Blush of Life, eating, drinking, or sex. (Source: Blood Stained Love, page 151)

looks__scene_kid.name: Scene Kid
looks__scene_kid.description: The player's style embodies that of a particular subculture. Add one die to all appropriate Social pools when dealing with that subculture. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

looks__stench.name: Stench
looks__stench.description: Supernaturally foul odor: −1 die to seduction/social pools; −2 dice to Stealth unless upwind.

looks__transparent.name: Transparent
looks__transparent.description: Unable to lie effectively: −1 die to any pools requiring Subterfuge; cannot buy dots in Subterfuge.

looks__unblinking_visage.name: Unblinking Visage
looks__unblinking_visage.description: Treat Humanity as −2 (min 0) for Blush of Life, eating, drinking, sex. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 45)

substance_use__high_functioning_addict.name: High Functioning Addict
substance_use__high_functioning_addict.description: If the last feeding contained the desired drug: +1 die to either a Physical, Social, or Mental pool (choose).

substance_use__addiction.name: Addiction
substance_use__addiction.description: If last feeding was not on the chosen drug: −1 die to all pools (unless the action is to get the drug).

substance_use__hopeless_addiction.name: Hopeless Addiction
substance_use__hopeless_addiction.description: If last feeding was not on the chosen drug: −2 dice to all pools (unless the action is to get the drug).

archaic__custodian_of_history.name: Custodian of History
archaic__custodian_of_history.description: +1 to relevant Skill tests about a chosen period/figure in Kindred lore. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade In Memoriam, page 20-21)

archaic__living_in_the_past.name: Living in the Past
archaic__living_in_the_past.description: Struggles with modern mindsets; one or more Convictions reflect outdated views.

archaic__archaic.name: Archaic
archaic__archaic.description: Cannot use computers/cellphones; Technology rating is always 0.

archaic__grief_phobia.name: Grief Phobia
archaic__grief_phobia.description: −1 die to all tests while in the presence of the phobic stimulus. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade In Memoriam, page 21)

archaic__old_tricks.name: Old Tricks
archaic__old_tricks.description: All specialties must be archaic (period-appropriate). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade In Memoriam, page 21)

bonding__bond_resistance.name: Bond Resistance
bonding__bond_resistance.description: +1 die per dot to resist Blood Bonds.

bonding__short_bond.name: Short Bond
bonding__short_bond.description: Bond levels decrease by two per month if not reinforced.

bonding__bonds_of_fealty.name: Bonds of Fealty
bonding__bonds_of_fealty.description: Dominate does not require eye contact on those bound to you (requires Dominate). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 44)

bonding__enduring_bond.name: Enduring Bond
bonding__enduring_bond.description: Bonds you create fade slower (weaken every other month). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 44)

bonding__bond_junkie.name: Bond Junkie
bonding__bond_junkie.description: Lose −1 die when acting against Blood Bonds.

bonding__long_bond.name: Long Bond
bonding__long_bond.description: Bonds fade slower: −1 level every 3 months.

bonding__bondslave.name: Bondslave
bonding__bondslave.description: Bond instantly with one drink (not three).

bonding__two_masters.name: Two Masters
bonding__two_masters.description: Can be Blood Bound to two individuals at once. (Source: Blood Stained Love, page 151)

feeding__iron_gullet.name: Iron Gullet
feeding__iron_gullet.description: Consume rancid/defractionated/otherwise inedible blood for others.

feeding__vessel_recognition.name: Vessel Recognition
feeding__vessel_recognition.description: Resolve + Awareness (Diff 2) to tell if a mortal was fed on recently; crit reveals if feed recurs. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 118)

feeding__drive-thru.name: Drive-thru
feeding__drive-thru.description: Safely complete a hunt within minutes while on the move by increasing the difficulty by 1. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 25)

feeding__vein_tapper.name: Vein Tapper
feeding__vein_tapper.description: Prefers personal/unaware feeding (drugged, unconscious, etc.). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 120)

feeding__prey_exclusion.name: Prey Exclusion
feeding__prey_exclusion.description: Cannot feed from a chosen group; doing so causes Stains as if breaking a Tenet.

feeding__farmer.name: Farmer
feeding__farmer.description: Must spend 2 Willpower to feed on human blood. (Ventrue cannot take.)

feeding__organovore.name: Organovore
feeding__organovore.description: Can only slake by consuming human flesh and organs.

feeding__outdated_preference.name: Outdated Preference
feeding__outdated_preference.description: Either force mortals to fit preference or always spend 1 WP to feed. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade In Memoriam, page 21)

feeding__resonance_sensitivity.name: Resonance Sensitivity
feeding__resonance_sensitivity.description: One resonance really messes with the character, causing a unique compulsion. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 25)

feeding__resonance_mimic.name: Resonance Mimic
feeding__resonance_mimic.description: The character gets influenced and penalized from the memories of their victim. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 25)

feeding__sloppy_feeder.name: Sloppy Feeder
feeding__sloppy_feeder.description: The pattern of attacks when feeding is telltale enough to identify. One attack can be linked to previous attacks. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 25)

feeding__starving_decay.name: Starving Decay
feeding__starving_decay.description: At Hunger 3+, body shrivels; −2 dice Physical tests & mortal socials; risks Masquerade. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 120)

mythic__eat_food.name: Eat Food
mythic__eat_food.description: Can consume food (no nourishment). It must be expelled before resting for the day.

mythic__cold_dead_hunger.name: Cold Dead Hunger
mythic__cold_dead_hunger.description: +2 dice to resist Hunger Frenzy. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Forbidden Religions, page 87)

mythic__pack_diablerie.name: Pack Diablerie
mythic__pack_diablerie.description: You take the soul during Diablerie unless you choose otherwise; helping another grants 5 XP as if you had committed it. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Forbidden Religions, page 87)

mythic__luck_of_the_devil.name: Luck of the Devil
mythic__luck_of_the_devil.description: Once per session redirect misfortune to someone close to the victim. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 119)

mythic__nuit_mode.name: Nuit Mode
mythic__nuit_mode.description: Body doesn't revert each night; keep new haircuts/body mods (mend like Aggravated). Not for BP > 1. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 119)

mythic__object_of_power.name: Object of Power
mythic__object_of_power.description: • Reroll 1 die per story (excl. Hunger). •• +1 die to all L1 Rituals. ••• Free danger premonition once/session. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade In Memoriam, page 21)

mythic__ley_line_leach.name: Ley Line Leach
mythic__ley_line_leach.description: Follow ancient paths of power while traveling. After traveling to a different city/locale, negate the need for a Rouse Check for the next night. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

mythic__persistent_blush.name: Persistent Blush
mythic__persistent_blush.description: A single activation of Blush of Life lasts 1 week. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

mythic__folkloric_bane.name: Folkloric Bane
mythic__folkloric_bane.description: Take Aggravated from a specific mythic object (e.g., silver).

mythic__folkloric_block.name: Folkloric Block
mythic__folkloric_block.description: Must spend Willpower or flee a mythic object (e.g., holy symbol).

mythic__stake_bait.name: Stake Bait
mythic__stake_bait.description: Meeting a stake results in Final Death.

mythic__twice_cursed.name: Twice Cursed
mythic__twice_cursed.description: Gain a second Clan's variant Bane in addition to your own (ST approval). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 121)

mythic__land_locked.name: Land Locked
mythic__land_locked.description: Unable to leave the land, the player must make a Fear Frenzy test at Difficulty 3 to board a boat or plane. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

mythic__resistant_blush.name: Resistant Blush
mythic__resistant_blush.description: When rolling a Rouse Check for Blush of Life, roll twice and take the lowest result. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

mythic__corpse_flesh.name: Corpse Flesh
mythic__corpse_flesh.description: Unable to use Blush of Life. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Live from the Succubus Club, page 26)

psychological__unholy_will.name: Unholy Will
psychological__unholy_will.description: Vs True Faith: +1 die and −1 holy damage at ••; +2 dice and −2 damage at ••••.

psychological__zealotry.name: Zealotry
psychological__zealotry.description: Once/session per dot: turn a normal success (aligned to a Conviction) into a Messy Critical.

psychological__penitence.name: Penitence
psychological__penitence.description: Once/session: take 1 Superficial Health to clear 1 Superficial Willpower.

psychological__soothed_beast.name: Soothed Beast
psychological__soothed_beast.description: With an SPC obsession: once/session ignore one Bestial or Messy Critical (gain 3 Stains if SPC dies). (Source: Blood Stained Love, page 151)

psychological__false_love.name: False Love
psychological__false_love.description: With an SPC obsession: treat Humanity as +1 (max 10) for Blush/eat/drink/sex near them; gain 3 Stains if they die. (Source: Blood Stained Love, page 151)

psychological__beacon_of_profanity.name: Beacon of Profanity
psychological__beacon_of_profanity.description: Mortals with any True Faith sense your presence.

psychological__crisis_of_faith.name: Crisis of Faith
psychological__crisis_of_faith.description: On a Bestial Failure: take 1 Superficial Willpower damage.

psychological__horrible_scars_of_peniten.name: Horrible Scars of Penitence
psychological__horrible_scars_of_peniten.description: Equivalent to Repulsive when around those outside the cult.

psychological__groveling_worm.name: Groveling Worm
psychological__groveling_worm.description: Must scourge flesh once per session for 2 Superficial Health or suffer 1 Aggravated Willpower next session. (Incompatible with Penitence.)

contagion__disease_vector.name: Disease Vector
contagion__disease_vector.description: Always contract illnesses when feeding on the sick and pass it to the next vessel.

contagion__plaguebringer.name: Plaguebringer
contagion__plaguebringer.description: Carries an unremovable disease. • minor but visible; •• potentially fatal if untreated; spreads via bite.

blood_ties__consanguineous_sense.name: Consanguineous Sense
blood_ties__consanguineous_sense.description: Detect whether another Kindred is in your direct bloodline (not their Generation). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 44)

blood_ties__consanguineous_influence.name: Consanguineous Influence
blood_ties__consanguineous_influence.description: Bonus dice on Mental Disciplines vs own Clan/ancestor/descendant (+2 dice within ±2 generations). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 44)

blood_ties__sins_of_the_father.name: Sins of the Father
blood_ties__sins_of_the_father.description: Show no signs after diablerizing a direct ancestor/descendant; at ••• extends to entire clan. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 44)

diablerie__blatant_diablerist.name: Blatant Diablerist
diablerie__blatant_diablerist.description: Powers/Merits sensing Diablerie always reveal it on you. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 45)

diablerie__inherited_bane.name: Inherited Bane
diablerie__inherited_bane.description: Gain another Clan's Bane in addition to your own (Tremere can use this to gain Salubri Bane). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Gehenna War, page 45)

other__check_the_trunk.name: Check the Trunk
other__check_the_trunk.description: Access to a modest armory/cache (≤ Resources 2 items). +2 dice to Preparation rolls.

other__side_hustler.name: Side Hustler
other__side_hustler.description: Once/session get an item, info, or access as if you had 2 dots in Resources/Contacts/Influence.

other__tempered_will.name: Tempered Will
other__tempered_will.description: Always feel Dominate/Presence attempts; once/session add +2 dice to a resistance pool. (Only if you have no dots in Dominate or Presence.)

other__untouchable.name: Untouchable
other__untouchable.description: Once per story, escape all official punishment that would otherwise destroy you.

other__mystic_of_the_void.name: Mystic of the Void
other__mystic_of_the_void.description: Count as knowing one Oblivion Power for ceremony prerequisites (Hecata/Lasombra choose three instead of one). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Tattered Façade, page 100)

other__knowledge_hungry.name: Knowledge Hungry
other__knowledge_hungry.description: Pick a topic at creation; when learning it, must roll Willpower (Diff 3) to resist pursuing. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 121)

other__prestation_debts.name: Prestation Debts
other__prestation_debts.description: Owe Kindred boons; boon-holder gains +1 die in Social conflict against you while leveraging this. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 121)

other__risk-taker_errata.name: Risk-Taker Errata
other__risk-taker_errata.description: When tempted by a new risky act, −2 dice to all actions until you do it or the scene ends.

other__weak-willed.name: Weak-Willed
other__weak-willed.description: Even when aware, you cannot use active resistance systems to avoid attempts to sway you.

caitiff__favored_blood.name: Favored Blood
caitiff__favored_blood.description: May purchase any Discipline without tasting another’s vitae first. (Incompatible with Muddled Blood.)

caitiff__mark_of_caine.name: Mark of Caine
caitiff__mark_of_caine.description: Gain +2 dice to intimidate/bully believers in Caine; attackers cannot add BP to diablerie roll; failure = Bestial failure.

caitiff__mockingbird.name: Mockingbird
caitiff__mockingbird.description: For one night after drinking a vampire's Blood: use one of their Disciplines (≤ your highest Discipline). You suffer their Bane for the night.

caitiff__sun-scarred.name: Sun-Scarred
caitiff__sun-scarred.description: First turn of sunlight: no Health damage, take 1 Aggravated Willpower, auto-succeed on Terror Frenzy; rest of scene: sun damage becomes Superficial.

caitiff__uncle_fangs.name: Uncle Fangs
caitiff__uncle_fangs.description: Allied local coterie of 3 to 5 thin-bloods (treat as Allies). Incompatible with Liquidator.

caitiff__befouling_vitae.name: Befouling Vitae
caitiff__befouling_vitae.description: Any mortal you Embrace or kill by feeding returns as a wight within nights.

caitiff__debt_peon.name: Debt Peon
caitiff__debt_peon.description: Owe boons to a high-status vampire; they gain +2 dice in Social combat when others are present.

caitiff__liquidator.name: Liquidator
caitiff__liquidator.description: −2 dice to Social pools against thin-bloods (except Intimidation). Incompatible with Uncle Fangs.

caitiff__muddled_blood.name: Muddled Blood
caitiff__muddled_blood.description: Must drink Blood of someone with a Discipline to buy dots in it. Incompatible with Favored Blood.

caitiff__walking_omen.name: Walking Omen
caitiff__walking_omen.description: Divinations point to you as the source of misfortune (ST adjudication).

caitiff__word-scarred.name: Word-Scarred
caitiff__word-scarred.description: Body covered with ancient vampiric lore text (ST adjudication).

thin-blood__catenating_blood.name: Catenating Blood
thin-blood__catenating_blood.description: Can create Blood Bonds and embrace thin-bloods.

thin-blood__day_drinker.name: Day Drinker
thin-blood__day_drinker.description: Walk in the sun; halves Health tracker; removes vampiric abilities in sunlight.

thin-blood__discipline_affinity.name: Discipline Affinity
thin-blood__discipline_affinity.description: Natural knack for one Discipline; gain 1 dot; retain extra levels at out-of-clan costs.

thin-blood__lifelike.name: Lifelike
thin-blood__lifelike.description: Heartbeat, can eat food, enjoy sex; most medical checks pass at night.

thin-blood__thin-blood_alchemist.name: Thin-blood Alchemist
thin-blood__thin-blood_alchemist.description: Gain 1 dot and 1 formula of Thin-blood Alchemy.

thin-blood__vampiric_resilience.name: Vampiric Resilience
thin-blood__vampiric_resilience.description: Take damage like a full vampire.

thin-blood__abhorrent_blood.name: Abhorrent Blood
thin-blood__abhorrent_blood.description: Vampires must spend 2 WP each turn to drink from you (mortals/TBA unaffected). (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__faith-proof.name: Faith-Proof
thin-blood__faith-proof.description: Too close to mortality for True Faith to affect you. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__low_appetite.name: Low Appetite
thin-blood__low_appetite.description: At sunset with Hunger 0 to 1, roll 2 dice for Rouse and take the highest. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__lucid_dreamer.name: Lucid Dreamer
thin-blood__lucid_dreamer.description: Once/session receive a clue from prior night or a hint about the story. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__mortality's_mien.name: Mortality's Mien
thin-blood__mortality's_mien.description: Auras don't reveal vampiric nature; +2 dice to appear mortal via other methods. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__swift_feeder.name: Swift Feeder
thin-blood__swift_feeder.description: Slake 1 Hunger in a turn and lick closed once/scene. (Source: Vampire: The Masquerade Players Guide, page 135)

thin-blood__shunned_by_the_anarchs.name: Shunned by the Anarchs
thin-blood__shunned_by_the_anarchs.description: Anarchs avoid you; more likely to throw you to Camarilla.

thin-blood__branded_by_the_camarilla.name: Branded by the Camarilla
thin-blood__branded_by_the_camarilla.description: Unhealable painful brand; can still take Camarilla Contact.

thin-blood__bestial_temper.name: Bestial Temper
thin-blood__bestial_temper.description: Frenzy as per full vampire rules.

thin-blood__clan_curse.name: Clan Curse
thin-blood__clan_curse.description: Gain a clan bane (Bane Severity 1); restricted options if certain merits taken.

thin-blood__vitae_dependency.name: Vitae Dependency
thin-blood__vitae_dependency.description: Must slake 1 Hunger of vampire vitae each week or lose all vampiric powers.

thin-blood__dead_flesh.name: Dead Flesh
thin-blood__dead_flesh.description: Medical inspections report deceased; −1 die to face-to-face Social vs mortals. (Incompatible with Lifelike.)

thin-blood__baby_teeth.name: Baby Teeth
thin-blood__baby_teeth.description: Fangs never developed or are too dull to feed.

thin-blood__mortal_frailty.name: Mortal Frailty
thin-blood__mortal_frailty.description: Mend like a mortal; cannot rouse the blood. (Incompatible with Vampiric Resilience.)

thin-blood__heliophobia.name: Heliophobia
thin-blood__heliophobia.description: Fear sunlight like full vampire; terror Frenzy from sunlight.

thin-blood__night_terrors.name: Night Terrors
thin-blood__night_terrors.description: Once/session suffer −1 die for all actions for rest of scene.

thin-blood__plague_bearers.name: Plague Bearers
thin-blood__plague_bearers.description: Susceptible to mortal illness; risk on every feed; mortal meds fail.

thin-blood__sloppy_drinker.name: Sloppy Drinker
thin-blood__sloppy_drinker.description: Dex + Medicine vs Diff = Hunger slaked; fail leaves ragged wound (Masquerade risk).

thin-blood__sun-faded.name: Sun-Faded
thin-blood__sun-faded.description: Alchemy/Disciplines unusable in sunlight; indoors by day at −2 dice if away from sunlight.

thin-blood__supernatural_tell.name: Supernatural Tell
thin-blood__supernatural_tell.description: Obvious to supernaturals; −2 dice to Stealth vs them.

thin-blood__twilight_presence.name: Twilight Presence
thin-blood__twilight_presence.description: Mortals avoid you; −1 die to Social pools vs others (not thin-bloods).

thin-blood__unending_hunger.name: Unending Hunger
thin-blood__unending_hunger.description: When feeding this scene, slake 1 fewer (once per scene).

ghouls__blood_empathy.name: Blood Empathy
ghouls__blood_empathy.description: Sense if your regnant is in danger/needing you (no telepathy).

ghouls__baneful_blood.name: Baneful Blood (Errata)
ghouls__baneful_blood.description: Experiences the Bane of first domitor (Lasombra, Malkavian, Ministry, Nosferatu, Ravnos, Salubri, or Toreador).

ghouls__crone's_curse.name: Crone's Curse (Errata)
ghouls__crone's_curse.description: Appears a decade older; −1 Health box.

ghouls__distressing_fangs.name: Distressing Fangs (Errata)
ghouls__distressing_fangs.description: Developed fangs; −1 die to Social with mortals.

cults__apocryphal_texts.name: Apocryphal Texts
cults__apocryphal_texts.description: The character possesses writings from one of the church's leaders. Gain two dice on applicable Intelligence rolls. (Can add a 1 dot optional Flaw where Willpower damage modifier for social combat is increased by 1).

cults__inspired_artist.name: Inspired Artist
cults__inspired_artist.description: When using the cult's symbols or message in art, add a 1-die penalty to onlookers to resist Social rolls from cult members.

cults__traveling_preacher.name: Traveling Preacher
cults__traveling_preacher.description: Having spread the cult's message where they go, reduce the difficulty on rolls to avoid the Second Inquisition by 1.

cults__excommunicated.name: Excommunicated
cults__excommunicated.description: They've done something to be cast out. At 1 dot, subtract 2 dice from all rolls dealing with the cult. At 2 dots, the cult actively seeks to destroy you.

cults__faithless.name: Faithless
cults__faithless.description: Being a member for the benefits. Lose two dice on rolls pertaining to the Cult from Resolve and Composure rolls. Cannot learn Rituals, Ceremonies, and Loresheets higher than level 2.

cults_ashfinders__memories_of_the_fallen.name: Memories of the Fallen (Thin-bloods)
cults_ashfinders__memories_of_the_fallen.description: On Ashe-related Alchemy rolls, one rolled 10 counts as two 10s (two 10s still count as four).

cults_ashfinders__streamer.name: Streamer
cults_ashfinders__streamer.description: Once per story, call upon your fanbase for a simple, non-violent task.

cults_ashfinders__ashe_addiction.name: Ashe Addiction
cults_ashfinders__ashe_addiction.description: After a failed Blood Alchemy roll, −2 dice to all actions until session ends.

cults_bahari__gardener.name: Gardener
cults_bahari__gardener.description: Equivalent to Herd for the Bahari faith.

cults_bahari__dark_mother's_song.name: Dark Mother's Song
cults_bahari__dark_mother's_song.description: +3 dice to Manipulation when convincing others to worship Lilith.

cults_church_of_caine__fire_resistant.name: Fire Resistant
cults_church_of_caine__fire_resistant.description: Convert a limited amount of Aggravated fire damage to Superficial during daysleep (per rules).

cults_church_of_caine__schism_(lasombra).name: Schism (Lasombra)
cults_church_of_caine__schism_(lasombra).description: −2 dice to Social rolls with members of your cult.

cults_church_of_set__vigilant.name: Vigilant
cults_church_of_set__vigilant.description: Know when you are being watched (not supernatural); still need a roll to identify who/where.

cults_church_of_set__fixer.name: Fixer
cults_church_of_set__fixer.description: Once per story, call in a favor or threaten a former client.

cults_church_of_set__false_alarm.name: False Alarm
cults_church_of_set__false_alarm.description: Every failed Awareness roll counts as a total failure.

cults_shalim__insidious_whispers.name: Insidious Whispers
cults_shalim__insidious_whispers.description: When undermining a Conviction, one rolled 10 counts as two 10s; two 10s still count as four.

cults_shalim__empty.name: Empty
cults_shalim__empty.description: People withdraw from your unnerving presence: −2 dice on Social rolls.

cults_mithraic__bull-slayer.name: Bull-Slayer
cults_mithraic__bull-slayer.description: On Extended Tests, reroll up to 3 regular dice once/scene without WP.

cults_mithraic__failed_initiate.name: Failed Initiate
cults_mithraic__failed_initiate.description: Assigned a meddling guide who interrupts plans/demands proof of worth.

cults_nephilim__archangel's_grace.name: Archangel's Grace
cults_nephilim__archangel's_grace.description: Swap Athletics ↔ Performance when doing heavy-cardio-like acts.

cults_nephilim__yearning.name: Yearning
cults_nephilim__yearning.description: Miss your master; spend 2 WP to act against their wishes.

coterie_clan_merits__call_to_purpose.name: Call to Purpose (Banu Haqim)
coterie_clan_merits__call_to_purpose.description: Once per session, they may motivate another teammate to gain the effect of a Willpower point to be immediately used. (Source: Companion, page 31 / Players Guide, page 179)

coterie_clan_merits__boot_and_rally.name: Boot and Rally (Brujah)
coterie_clan_merits__boot_and_rally.description: Once per session, a coterie mate may reroll all regular dice on a failed Physical test. (Source: Companion, page 31 / Players Guide, page 180)

coterie_clan_merits__pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics (Gangrel)
coterie_clan_merits__pack_tactics.description: When in combat gain a single die to pools for Brawl or Melee attacks when together. (Source: Companion, page 32 / Players Guide, page 181)

coterie_clan_merits__ars_moriendi.name: Ars Moriendi (Hecata)
coterie_clan_merits__ars_moriendi.description: Once per session, they can mask the corpse of someone killed. (Source: Companion, page 32 / Players Guide, page 182)

coterie_clan_merits__at_any_cost.name: At Any Cost (Lasombra)
coterie_clan_merits__at_any_cost.description: Once per session, add two successes to a test. The outcome is treated as a Messy Critical. (Source: Companion, page 33 / Players Guide, page 182)

coterie_clan_merits__everything_is_conne.name: Everything is Connected (Malkavian)
coterie_clan_merits__everything_is_conne.description: Once per session, another member of the coterie may substitute one skill for another on a test involving information gathering. (Source: Companion, page 34 / Players Guide, page 183)

coterie_clan_merits__discerning.name: Discerning (The Ministry)
coterie_clan_merits__discerning.description: Once per session the Minister character may learn something about a Storytellers character's wants as long as a member of the coterie has spoken to them. (Source: Companion, page 36 / Players Guide, page 184)

coterie_clan_merits__contextual_contact.name: Contextual Contact (Nosferatu)
coterie_clan_merits__contextual_contact.description: Once per session, the Nosferatu may add the highest-rated coterie members' contact rating to any one test to recover information. (Source: Companion, page 36 / Players Guide, page 185)

coterie_clan_merits__cryptolect.name: Cryptolect (Ravnos)
coterie_clan_merits__cryptolect.description: Allows the coterie to communicate in coded language and hand signs. (Source: Companion, page 37 / Players Guide, page 185)

coterie_clan_merits__restraint.name: Restraint (Salubri)
coterie_clan_merits__restraint.description: Once per session, the Salubri can allow another member of their group to reroll all of their Hunger dice in a test for free. (Source: Players Guide, page 187)

coterie_clan_merits__all_access.name: All Access (Toreador)
coterie_clan_merits__all_access.description: One per session, they can get past bouncers to get into a mortal event by being on the list or knowing the right connections. (Source: Companion, page 38 / Players Guide, page 187)

coterie_clan_merits__multi-level_lorekee.name: Multi-Level Lorekeeping (Tremere)
coterie_clan_merits__multi-level_lorekee.description: Once per session, someone can use another's loresheet within the coterie including clan specific. (Source: Companion, page 38 / Players Guide, page 188)

coterie_clan_merits__old-world_hospitali.name: Old-World Hospitality (Tzimisce)
coterie_clan_merits__old-world_hospitali.description: When daysleeping in the Tzimisce's haven, they regain an additional Superficial Willpower damage. (Source: Companion, page 39 / Players Guide, page 189)

coterie_clan_merits__kindred_legacies.name: Kindred Legacies (Ventrue)
coterie_clan_merits__kindred_legacies.description: Once per session, the Ventrue may ask for relevant information about the history of a single vampire they've met. (Source: Companion, page 31 / Players Guide, page 187)

coterie_clan_merits__versatile_vitae.name: Versatile Vitae (Caitiff)
coterie_clan_merits__versatile_vitae.description: Once per session, the Caitiff can enable another coterie mate to use a Discipline power they do not possess assuming they have the Discipline levels and other pre-requisites for the duration of one scene. (Source: Players Guide, page 187)

coterie_clan_merits__mortal_heart.name: Mortal Heart (Thin-blood)
coterie_clan_merits__mortal_heart.description: Once per session, the coterie may be reminded by the thin-blood what it means to be alive and count their Humanity as one dot higher for one scene. (Source: Players Guide, page 187)

backgrounds_allies__allies.name: Allies
backgrounds_allies__allies.description:
Mortals who support and help the character, such as family, associates, or mortal groups. Built from two dot pools: Effectiveness (• to ••••) and Reliability (• to •••), maximum 6 dots total.
Effectiveness:
• One dot: A mortal with modest skills or minor influence.
•• Two dots: An average mortal capable of combat or local influence.
••• Three dots: A gifted mortal, detective, mob lieutenant, or skilled specialist.
•••• Four dots: A deadly mortal, SWAT leader, corporate executive, or high politician.
Reliability:
• One dot: Appears if completely safe and convenient (roll 1 die, 1 to 5 means unavailable).
•• Two dots: Appears unless suicidal or directly against their interests (roll 1 die, 1 to 3 means unavailable).
••• Three dots: Always answers the call and goes out of their way, no roll needed.

backgrounds_allies__enemy.name: Enemy
backgrounds_allies__enemy.description: A mortal or mortal organization actively working against the character. Rated in effectiveness and reliability identically to Allies, but represents a persistent threat or adversary equal to its rating.

backgrounds_contacts__contacts.name: Contacts
backgrounds_contacts__contacts.description:
Mortals who provide information, services, or gear. Unlike Allies, Contacts do not fight or take personal risks for the vampire.
• One dot: A bartender, beat cop, or petty clerk providing minor favors, low level gossip, or common items.
•• Two dots: A precinct detective, city hall bureaucrat, arms dealer, or emergency room nurse providing privileged records, alerts, or specialty items.
••• Three dots: A chief of police, federal agent, hospital director, or judge who can make investigations vanish, provide federal files, or arrange security clearance.

backgrounds_fame__fame.name: Fame
backgrounds_fame__fame.description:
Public notoriety in mortal or Kindred society. Adds bonus dice to Social pools targeting mortals or fans who recognize you, but carries obvious Masquerade visibility risks.
• One dot: Subcultural fame or minor local scene prominence.
•• Two dots: Local celebrity, municipal news regular, or well known athlete.
••• Three dots: Statewide or regional celebrity, recognizable face.
•••• Four dots: National fame, household name across the country.
••••• Five dots: Global star or internationally recognized icon.

backgrounds_fame__influencer.name: Influencer
backgrounds_fame__influencer.description: Requires Fame ••+. Have the equivalent Influence rating equal to your Fame minus one towards a fan or related field once per story.
backgrounds_fame__influencer.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_fame__enduring_fame.name: Enduring Fame
backgrounds_fame__enduring_fame.description: Requires Fame •••+. Fame lost during the story fully recovers at the start of the next story.
backgrounds_fame__enduring_fame.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_fame__dark_secret.name: Dark Secret
backgrounds_fame__dark_secret.description: A dangerous secret known to a few dedicated enemies. Exposure would cause ruin or execution.

backgrounds_fame__infamy.name: Infamy
backgrounds_fame__infamy.description: You did something atrocious and others know. Disadvantage on Social tests against those aware of your deeds.

backgrounds_fame__banned_from.name: Banned From
backgrounds_fame__banned_from.description: Barred from entering a territory or city: small district = •, medium city = ••, large metropolis = •••.

backgrounds_influence__influence.name: Influence
backgrounds_influence__influence.description:
Sway over mortal institutions including politics, judiciary, underworld, media, and finance.
• One dot: Influence over a neighborhood council, local gang, or single bureau.
•• Two dots: Influence over a municipal city department, police precinct, or borough.
••• Three dots: City wide influence over mayor office, magistrates, or media network.
•••• Four dots: Regional or state wide sway over legislation and judicial bodies.
••••• Five dots: Federal or nationwide influence over continental institutions.

backgrounds_influence__disliked.name: Disliked
backgrounds_influence__disliked.description: Suffer a one die penalty to Social pools vs groups outside your loyal followers.

backgrounds_influence__despised.name: Despised
backgrounds_influence__despised.description: One group or faction actively works to undermine and ruin your plans.

backgrounds_haven__haven.name: Haven
backgrounds_haven__haven.description:
A secure, private shelter protected from sunlight and mortal intrusion.
• One dot: Small apartment, basement, or crypt with basic locks and blackout curtains.
•• Two dots: Single family house, secure loft, or reinforced hideout.
••• Three dots: Fortified mansion, underground compound, or private bank vault.

backgrounds_haven__hidden_armory.name: Hidden Armory
backgrounds_haven__hidden_armory.description: Each dot adds concealed firearms and weapons stored securely within the haven.

backgrounds_haven__cell.name: Cell
backgrounds_haven__cell.description: Secure holding cell for two prisoners. Extra dots double capacity or increase escape difficulty by +1.

backgrounds_haven__watchmen.name: Watchmen
backgrounds_haven__watchmen.description: Each dot provides 4 Average Mortals and 1 Gifted Mortal as perimeter guards.

backgrounds_haven__laboratory.name: Laboratory
backgrounds_haven__laboratory.description: Dedicated lab adding bonus dice to Science, Technology, or Blood Alchemy (Fixatio). Not for 1 dot havens.

backgrounds_haven__library.name: Library
backgrounds_haven__library.description: Research archives adding bonus dice to Academics, Investigation, or Occult pools.

backgrounds_haven__location.name: Location
backgrounds_haven__location.description: Prime geographic location adding +2 dice (or +2 enemy Difficulty) to relevant Chasse or Haven tests.

backgrounds_haven__luxury.name: Luxury
backgrounds_haven__luxury.description: Opulent appointments adding +2 dice to Social tests with mortals inside the haven.

backgrounds_haven__postern.name: Postern
backgrounds_haven__postern.description: Concealed escape tunnel adding +1 die per dot to evasion tests near the haven.

backgrounds_haven__security_system.name: Security System
backgrounds_haven__security_system.description: Reinforced security adding +1 die per dot to resist unauthorized entry or surveillance.

backgrounds_haven__surgery.name: Surgery
backgrounds_haven__surgery.description: Surgical suite adding +2 dice to Medicine and healing tests conducted inside.

backgrounds_haven__warding.name: Warding
backgrounds_haven__warding.description: Occult wards adding +1 die per dot to resist supernatural scrying or intrusion.

backgrounds_haven__holy_ground.name: Holy Ground
backgrounds_haven__holy_ground.description: Call upon cultists to defend the sanctuary once per story.

backgrounds_haven__shrine.name: Shrine
backgrounds_haven__shrine.description: Altar providing bonus equal to dots when preparing Ritual or Ceremony components.

backgrounds_haven__business_establishmen.name: Business Establishment
backgrounds_haven__business_establishmen.description: Commercial venue providing revenue stream alongside shelter.

backgrounds_haven__furcus.name: Furcus
backgrounds_haven__furcus.description: Ley line convergence adding +1 die per dot to Rituals and Ceremonies performed on site.

backgrounds_haven__machine_shop.name: Machine Shop
backgrounds_haven__machine_shop.description: Industrial workspace adding +1 die per dot to Craft machinery and fabrication pools.

backgrounds_haven__mobile.name: Mobile
backgrounds_haven__mobile.description: Vehicle haven (van, boat, RV, or converted transport). Size scales with dots.
backgrounds_haven__mobile.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_haven__armored.name: Armored
backgrounds_haven__armored.description: Reinforced mobile haven plating capable of absorbing 10 points of damage.
backgrounds_haven__armored.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_haven__smugglers_stash.name: Smugglers Stash
backgrounds_haven__smugglers_stash.description: Secret concealment compartment within haven. Searches face +2 difficulty.
backgrounds_haven__smugglers_stash.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_haven__spare_plates.name: Spare Plates
backgrounds_haven__spare_plates.description: Quick change registration and identifiers switchable in a single turn.
backgrounds_haven__spare_plates.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 25

backgrounds_haven__no_haven.name: No Haven
backgrounds_haven__no_haven.description: No secure shelter. Must make a survival test nightly to find daytime rest.

backgrounds_haven__creepy.name: Creepy
backgrounds_haven__creepy.description: Suffer a two dice penalty to Social pools with mortals while inside the haven.

backgrounds_haven__haunted.name: Haunted
backgrounds_haven__haunted.description: Supernatural apparition or malevolent entity haunts the premises.

backgrounds_haven__compromised.name: Compromised
backgrounds_haven__compromised.description: Haven is known to authorities, the Second Inquisition, or mortal enemies.

backgrounds_haven__shared.name: Shared
backgrounds_haven__shared.description: Haven is co owned with mortals or landlord with access rights.

backgrounds_haven__on_the_rails.name: On the Rails
backgrounds_haven__on_the_rails.description: Mobile haven movement is scheduled and not under player direct control.
backgrounds_haven__on_the_rails.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 26

backgrounds_haven__temperamental.name: Temperamental
backgrounds_haven__temperamental.description: Vehicle haven is mechanically unreliable. Failed Drive tests halt the vehicle.
backgrounds_haven__temperamental.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 26

backgrounds_herd__herd.name: Herd
backgrounds_herd__herd.description:
Accessible, willing kine vessels allowing safe feeding without rolling hunting tests.
• One dot: 1 to 2 vessels, slakes 1 Hunger per week without tests.
•• Two dots: 3 to 7 vessels, slakes 2 Hunger per week without tests.
••• Three dots: 8 to 15 vessels, slakes 3 Hunger per week without tests.
•••• Four dots: 16 to 30 vessels, slakes 4 Hunger per week without tests.
••••• Five dots: Large cult or institution, slakes all Hunger needs safely.

backgrounds_herd__obvious_predator.name: Obvious Predator
backgrounds_herd__obvious_predator.description: Suffer a two dice penalty to hunting tests other than stalking or killing. Suffer a one die penalty to Social pools to calm mortals. Cannot maintain a Herd.

backgrounds_mask__mask.name: Mask
backgrounds_mask__mask.description:
A complete false identity within mortal government and financial systems.
• One dot: Fake identification, driver license, and social media presence.
•• Two dots: Complete legal identity with birth records, bank accounts, and passport.

backgrounds_mask__zeroed.name: Zeroed
backgrounds_mask__zeroed.description: Requires 2 dot Mask. Erased from government and intelligence surveillance systems.

backgrounds_mask__cobbler.name: Cobbler
backgrounds_mask__cobbler.description: Requires 2 dot Mask. Skilled at fabricating fake identities for others in 3 days per dot.

backgrounds_mask__known_corpse.name: Known Corpse
backgrounds_mask__known_corpse.description: Publicly registered as deceased. Encountering relatives or officials invites immediate scrutiny.

backgrounds_mask__known_blankbody.name: Known Blankbody
backgrounds_mask__known_blankbody.description: Listed as an active blankbody in Second Inquisition and agency databases.

backgrounds_mawla__mawla.name: Mawla
backgrounds_mawla__mawla.description:
A vampire mentor or patron who provides guidance, status protection, and resources.
• One dot: A neonate with slightly more experience or useful ties.
•• Two dots: An established ancilla with moderate social influence.
••• Three dots: A respected Primogen, Whip, or city elder.
•••• Four dots: An influential High Harpy, Seneschal, or powerful elder.
••••• Five dots: A Prince, Archbishop, or ancient Methuselah.

backgrounds_mawla__secret_master.name: Secret Master
backgrounds_mawla__secret_master.description: Your Mawla assigns covert operations and covert missions. Requires Mawla.

backgrounds_mawla__adversary.name: Adversary
backgrounds_mawla__adversary.description: A vampire rival or enemy who actively schemes against you. Rated two dots higher than equal Mawla.

backgrounds_mawla__shameful_childe.name: Shameful Childe
backgrounds_mawla__shameful_childe.description: You Embraced and abandoned a childe whose actions cause constant political embarrassment.

backgrounds_mawla__touchstone_embraced_b.name: Touchstone Embraced by your Enemies
backgrounds_mawla__touchstone_embraced_b.description: A former mortal Touchstone was Embraced by hostile vampires. Confronting them risks Stains.

backgrounds_resources__resources.name: Resources
backgrounds_resources__resources.description:
Liquid wealth, monthly revenue, capital assets, and luxury access.
• One dot: Working class living, modest savings, modest apartment or room.
•• Two dots: Middle class living, comfortable apartment or house, personal vehicle.
••• Three dots: Affluent living, high disposable income, luxury vehicle, luxury investments.
•••• Four dots: High net worth, multi millionaire, substantial holdings, yacht or estate.
••••• Five dots: Ultra high net worth, multi billionaire, corporate titan with global reach.

backgrounds_resources__destitute.name: Destitute
backgrounds_resources__destitute.description: Completely destitute with no money, bank accounts, or owned possessions beyond clothing.

backgrounds_retainers__retainers.name: Retainers
backgrounds_retainers__retainers.description:
Mortal or ghoul servants bound by blood, money, or loyalty.
• One dot: A normal mortal servant, assistant, or driver.
•• Two dots: A gifted mortal specialist or basic Ghoul.
••• Three dots: A skilled combat Ghoul with 1 dot in a physical Discipline.

backgrounds_retainers__stalkers.name: Stalkers
backgrounds_retainers__stalkers.description: Dangerously obsessed mortals follow you. Eliminating one soon attracts another.

backgrounds_status__status.name: Status
backgrounds_status__status.description:
Formal standing, respect, and authority within the character sect or vampire society.
• One dot: Recognized neonate in good standing.
•• Two dots: Respected ancilla or trusted domain agent.
••• Three dots: Influential elder or respected authority figure.
•••• Four dots: Primogen, Baron, Sheriff, or high city official.
••••• Five dots: Prince, Archbishop, Archon, or Justicar.

backgrounds_status__city_secrets.name: City Secrets
backgrounds_status__city_secrets.description: Privileged knowledge of local Kindred conspiracies and power structures.

backgrounds_status__suspect.name: Suspect
backgrounds_status__suspect.description: Angered a faction. Suffer a two dice penalty to Social tests with offended groups.

backgrounds_status__shunned.name: Shunned
backgrounds_status__shunned.description: Despised by a sect or faction who actively works against your interests.

backgrounds_status__mortal_pretender.name: Mortal Pretender
backgrounds_status__mortal_pretender.description: Leading an excessive mortal life unsettling your Kindred peers. Suffer a two dice penalty to Social tests against Masquerade traditionalists.
backgrounds_status__mortal_pretender.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 26

Alleycat.name: Alleycat
Alleycat.desc: Those who find violence to be the quickest way to get what they want might gravitate towards this hunting style. Alleycats are a vampire who feeds by brute force and outright attack and feeds from whomever they can when they can. Intimidation is a route easily taken to make their victims cower or even Dominating the victims to not report the attack or mask it as something else entirely. Strength + Brawl is to take blood by force or threat. Wits + Streetwise can be used to find criminals as if a vigilante figure.

Bagger.name: Bagger
Bagger.desc: Sometimes the best blood doesn't come from a live body. Baggers are kindred who take an approach most are unable to with their ability to consume preserved, defractionated or rancid blood through (•••) Iron Gullet, allowing them to feed from unusual sources such as blood bags or corpses. Perhaps they work in a hospital or blood bank or they might even have enough knowledge about the black market to obtain their blood. Ventrue are unable to pick this Predator type. Intelligence + Streetwise can be used to find, gain access and purchase the goods.

Blood Leech.name: Blood Leech
Blood Leech.desc: Some Kindred might see feeding from mortals as inherently wrong or disgusting regardless of others' rationale. Blood Leech is a feeding style that is not looked upon kindly by many vampires making it risky unless the Kindred has a position of power and can keep their little secret secure. Regardless, with their rejection of mortal blood, they instead feed upon the vitae of other vampires through hunting those weaker than them, coercion, or taking Blood as payment. This Predator Type is suggested to not be abstracted down to a dice pool.

Cleaver.name: Cleaver
Cleaver.desc: The sweetest blood might be from those closest to them, the Cleaver takes advantage of that idea while taking blood from either their own close family and friends or even those close to someone else. Covertly stealing the blood from their victims while still maintaining ties to them. Cleavers will go to extreme lengths to keep their condition a secret from their victims but some may instead take a less than pleasant route. The Camarilla forbids the practice of taking a human family in this fashion, as it's a breach waiting to happen. Manipulation + Subterfuge is used to condition the victims, socializing with them and feeding from them without the cover being blown. This hunting style is typically rare for ancilla or older characters due to inherent risk or becoming otherwise unsustainable over time.

Consensualist.name: Consensualist
Consensualist.desc: Consent is a dangerous thing to gather when they're a blood-sucking monster, but Consensualists make do. They never feed against the victim's free will, instead pretending to be a representative of a charity blood drive, someone with a blood kink within the kink community, or blatantly admitting to their victims what they are and getting their permission to feed. To the Camarilla, the last method is considered a masquerade breach but perhaps to a philosophical Anarch, it might be an acceptable risk to take. Manipulation + Persuasion allows the kindred to take blood by consent, under the guide of medical work or mutual kink. This hunting style is typically rare for ancilla or older characters due to inherent risk or becoming otherwise unsustainable over time.

Farmer.name: Farmer
Farmer.desc: Perhaps this vampire was once someone who worked as an activist or an aid worker, regardless of their reasoning the Farmer only feed from animals as their primary source of blood. The beast may gnaw at them with its throes of hunger, but they've successfully managed to avoid killing mortals except on the occasional bad night. Ventrue may not pick this Predator type and it cannot be taken on characters with Blood Potency 3 or higher. Composure + Animal Ken is the roll to find and catch the chosen animal. This hunting style is typically rare for ancilla or older characters due to inherent risk or becoming otherwise unsustainable over time.

Osiris.name: Osiris
Osiris.desc: More than not, Osiris are celebrities within mortal society. Musicians, writers, priests, and even cult leaders may find an easy time finding their blood by utilizing those already around them. They tend to feed from their fans or worshippers which means they have easy access to blood, but followers tend to attract their own problems with the local authority or worse. Manipulation + Subterfuge or Intimidation + Fame are both used to feed from the adoring fans.

Sandman.name: Sandman
Sandman.desc: If they never wake during the feed it never happened, right? Sandman prefers to hunt on sleeping mortals than anyone else by using stealth or Disciplines to feed from their victims they are rarely caught in the act, though when they are, problems are sure to occur. Maybe they were anti-social in life or perhaps they find the route of seduction or violence too much for them and find comfort in the silence of this feeding style. Dexterity + Stealth is for casing a location, breaking in and feeding without leaving a trace.

Scene Queen.name: Scene Queen
Scene Queen.desc: Similar to Osiris these Kindred find comfort in a particular subculture rather than a wider audience. Hunting in or around a subculture they likely belonged to in their previous life, their victims adore them for their status, and those who have an inkling of what they are disbelieved. The scene itself could be anything, from street culture to high fashion, and the unifying trait is the use of those around them. Manipulation + Persuasion aids in feeding from those within the Kindred subgroup, through conditioning and isolation to gain blood or gaslighting or forced silence.

Siren.name: Siren
Siren.desc: Everyone knows that sex sells and the Siren uses this to their advantage. Almost exclusively feeding while feigning sex or sexual interest, they utilize Disciplines and seduction to lure away a possible meal. Moving through clubs and one-night stands are skills they've mastered and regardless of how sexy they feel, deep in their darkest moments, they realize at best they are problematic and at worst a serial sexual assaulter. In life, they might have been a scriptwriter, a small time actor who never reached the big screen, a well-known kinkster or even a virgin looking to make up for the lost time. Charisma + Subterfuge is how sirens feed under the guise of sexual acts.

Extortionist.name: Extortionist
Extortionist.desc: Found in Cults of the Blood Gods. On the surface, Extortionists acquire their blood in exchange for services such as protection, security, or surveillance. Though, for as many times as the service might be genuine, there are many more times when the service has been offered from fabricated information to make the deal feel that much sweeter. Strength or Manipulation + Intimidation to feed through coercion.

Graverobber.name: Graverobber
Graverobber.desc: Found in Cults of the Blood Gods. Similar to Baggers these kindred understand there's no good in wasting good blood, even if others cannot consume it. Often they find themselves digging up corpses or working for mortuaries to obtain their bodies, yet regardless of what the name suggests, they prefer feeding from mourners at a gravesite or a hospital. This Predator Type often requires a haven or other connections to a church, hospital, or morgue as a way to obtain the bodies. Resolve + Medicine for sifting through the dead for a body with blood. Manipulation + Insight for moving among miserable mortals.

Roadside Killer.name: Roadside Killer
Roadside Killer.desc: Found in Let the Streets Run Red and Live from the Succubus Club. These Kindred never stay in one spot for too long and are always on the move, hunting those who won't be missed if they disappear alongside the road. Roadside Killers know the risk is just as worth as the reward. Perhaps this Kindred was once a truck driver themselves or maybe they met their fate alongside the road as well. Dexterity or Charisma + Drive to feed by picking up down-and-outs with no other options.

Grim Reaper.name: Grim Reaper
Grim Reaper.desc: Found in Players Guide. Hunting inside hospice care facilities, assisted living homes, and other places where those who are near death reside. Grim Reapers are constantly on the move in an effort to locate new victims near the end of their lives to feed from. Hunting in this style may also earn a taste for specific diseases making them easier to identify. Intelligence + Awareness or Medicine in order to find victims.

Montero.name: Montero
Montero.desc: Found in Players Guide. Montero carry on a tradition held by aristocratic Spaniards where they hunted deer and used teams to drive them into the huntsman. Retainers drive the victims towards the vampire for them to feed. This is not always done in the traditional style but in the forms of long cons, flash mobs, or gang pursuits. Intelligence + Stealth represents the expert planning of well-trained Retainers, whereas a well-practiced plan and patient waiting is represented by Resolve + Stealth.

Pursuer.name: Pursuer
Pursuer.desc: Found in Players Guide. For those who prefer to stalk their victim, learning their habits and routines, determining if they will cause an outcry if they disappear or not. The Pursuer strikes when the time is right and when hunger is at a perfect balance. Intelligence + Investigation to locate and find a victim no one will notice is gone. Stamina + Stealth for long stalking of unaware urban victims.

Trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
Trapdoor.rolls: Charisma + Stealth • Dexterity + Stealth • Wits + Awareness (+ Haven)
Trapdoor.desc: Found in Players Guide. Much like the spider, this vampire builds a nest and lures their prey inside. Be it an amusement park, an abandoned house, or an underground club, the victim comes to them. There the trapdoor might only play with their mind and terrorize them, imprison them to drain them slowly, or take a deep drink and then send them home. Charisma + Stealth for the victims that enter expecting a fun-filled night. Dexterity + Stealth to feed upon trespassers. Wits + Awareness (+ Haven) is used to navigate the maze of the den itself.

Tithe Collector.name: Tithe Collector
Tithe Collector.desc: Found in In Memoriam. This predator type is intended for ancilla characters. They hold enough power that other Kindred around them pay tribute in the form of specially selected vessels, who are delivered regularly, or upon request. The vessels must be kept in reasonable condition and returned, but otherwise the Masquerade is everyone else's problem.

Blood Cult.name: Blood Cult
Blood Cult.notes: Entices mortals into rituals; take their blood and possibly enslave them.

Carnival.name: Carnival
Carnival.notes: Mobile troupe: theater, politics, rites, or hidden in plain sight.

Cerberus.name: Cerberus
Cerberus.notes: Protect a specific spot or item.

Champions.name: Champions
Champions.notes: Fight for a cause in mortal or kindred society.

Commando.name: Commando
Commando.notes: Built to fight enemies; mission-tasked by a Mawla.

Day Watch.name: Day Watch
Day Watch.notes: Protect someone/something in the day; often thin-blood Day Drinkers.

Diocese.name: Diocese
Diocese.notes: Large cultic structure with mortal-facing front.

Excommunicates.name: Excommunicates
Excommunicates.notes: On the cult’s blacklist; often carry cult-related Flaws.

Family.name: Family
Family.notes: Reliance and support network; mortal & clan ties.

Flagellant.name: Flagellant
Flagellant.notes: Redemption through charity or hunting abusive Kindred.

Fugitive.name: Fugitive
Fugitive.notes: On the run; always carries Flaws tied to the pursuer.

Gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
Gatekeeper.notes: Communion with / control over the dead; spiritual aid and sabotage.

Hunting Party.name: Hunting Party
Hunting Party.notes: Specialists in capturing humans with special blood.

Missionaries.name: Missionaries
Missionaries.notes: Seed a Blood Cult or Diocese; convert others.

Plumaire.name: Plumaire
Plumaire.notes: United by social prominence or shared enthusiasms.

Questari.name: Questari
Questari.notes: Pursue a major accomplishment, relic, or mystery.

Rectorate.name: Rectorate
Rectorate.notes: Hunters of magical relics and objects.

Regency.name: Regency
extras: Up to 10 dots among Haven/Herd/Influence/Resources/Retainers/Status: City Secrets/Coterie Advantages
Equal dots of Flaws among Adversaries/Compromised Haven/Despised/Enemies/Stalkers/Coterie Flaws
Regency.notes: Watch over an elder’s domain; wield their political power.

Sbirri.name: Sbirri
Sbirri.notes: Posing as another type; actually spies for a rival faction/sect. Spend one less dot overall.

Schism.name: Schism
Schism.notes: Leading a schism in a cult or splinter group.

Support Group.name: Support Group
Support Group.notes: Mutual aid (especially fledglings) to survive unlife.

Theologian Society.name: Theologian Society
Theologian Society.notes: Dark magic dabblers or theological researchers within cults.

Watchmen.name: Watchmen
Watchmen.notes: Patrol the city, repel intruders, colonize territory.

Archonium.name: Archonium
Archonium.notes: Justicar’s expendable enforcers; diplomats/spies operating under cover.

Primogen's Council.name: Primogen's Council
extras: Members often donate personal Advantage dots to shared pool; ‘supervillain lair’ vibe
Primogen's Council.notes: Council constantly at covert war yet unites against external threats.

Prince's Court.name: Prince's Court
extras: Court often has shared Status •••• in Camarilla domains
Prince's Court.notes: Rules a smaller city or a major domain within a megacity.

The Decade Club.name: The Decade Club
extras: Mythic Flaw (• or ••) suitable to the era
The Decade Club.notes: Informal club bound by a shared decade/era, values, and holdings.

Brujah.bane: Short Fuse: when provoked or confronted, the difficulty of all tests to resist Frenzy increases by an amount equal to the Bane Severity.
Brujah.compulsion: Contempt: overcome with open disgust for surrounding weakness or hypocrisy; taking a two dice penalty to all tests involving cooperation.

Gangrel.bane: Predatory Urges: when threatened or startled, the vampire loses a number of dice equal to Bane Severity on any Mental or Social test requiring calm reflection.
Gangrel.compulsion: Territorial Aggression: compelled to mark and aggressively defend their immediate perimeter; taking a two dice penalty to tests away from the marked zone.

Malkavian.bane: Sensory Deluge: flashes of sensory insight or chaotic impressions distract the vampire; taking a penalty equal to Bane Severity on Perception and Awareness tests in chaotic environments.
Malkavian.compulsion: Paranoia: convinced that allies or strangers are concealing a catastrophic revelation; taking a two dice penalty to tests relying on trust.

Nosferatu.bane: Pestilence: the vampire carries a swarm of vermin, fleas, or sewer grime; taking a penalty equal to Bane Severity on tests to leave no physical traces or forensic evidence behind.
Nosferatu.compulsion: Hoarding: compelled to acquire, stash, or conceal a piece of physical or digital contraband in the scene; taking a two dice penalty to other tasks.

Toreador.bane: Disdain of the Ordinary: when surrounded by mundane, cheap, or ugly surroundings, the vampire loses dice equal to Bane Severity on all non aggressive tests.
Toreador.compulsion: Enraptured Critique: compelled to critique, mock, or correct the artistic flaws or manners of someone in the scene; taking a two dice penalty to unrelated actions.

Tremere.bane: Hermetic Pride: the vampire cannot bring themselves to accept magical guidance from non Tremere; taking a penalty equal to Bane Severity on collaborative occult tests with outsiders.
Tremere.compulsion: Dogmatism: compelled to follow rigid hierarchy, ritual protocols, or scholarly order; taking a two dice penalty to spontaneous or improvised tests.

Ventrue.bane: Exclusive Vintage: the vampire can only feed from mortals with a narrow psychological trait, profession, or lineage; feeding from any other mortal fails completely.
Ventrue.compulsion: Noblesse Oblige: compelled to assert aristocratic protection or dominance over their subordinates; taking a two dice penalty to actions where they do not lead.

Banu Haqim.bane: Slaking Thirst: the vampire cannot slake Hunger from mortal vessels unless the mortal has committed a crime, broken a law, or violated a personal or chronicle Tenet.
Banu Haqim.compulsion: Righteous Indignation: fixates on righting a perceived wrong or injustice in the scene; taking a two dice penalty to all tests not directed at punishing the guilty.

Hecata.bane: Corpse Cold: the vampire feels uncomfortably cold and smells faintly of formaldehyde and wet earth; taking a penalty equal to Bane Severity to all Social pools with mortals.
Hecata.compulsion: Morbid Fascination: driven to examine, collect, or catalog traces of mortality, autopsy details, or death relics; taking a two dice penalty to all unrelated tests.

Lasombra.bane: Disturbed Shadows: shadows cast by the vampire twist, flicker, and stretch unnaturally; the vampire loses dice equal to Bane Severity on Stealth and subtle Social tests in visible light.
Lasombra.compulsion: Hubris: overcome by extreme pride and dismissal of inferior Kindred or kine; taking a two dice penalty on all rolls where they accept help or advice.

The Ministry.bane: Cold Blooded: in cold temperatures or darkness without warmth, the vampire becomes lethargic and loses dice equal to Bane Severity on all Physical tests.
The Ministry.compulsion: Sin Eater: driven to tempt another into committing an immoral or forbidden act; taking a two dice penalty to all other actions until the sin is committed.

Ravnos.bane: Restless Blood: if the vampire rests in the same neighborhood for more than three consecutive nights, they lose dice equal to Bane Severity on all rolls until relocating.
Ravnos.compulsion: Showmanship: compelled to demonstrate superiority or trick an opponent through flash and spectacle; taking a two dice penalty to direct, simple actions.

Salubri.bane: Empathetic Bleed: when a creature in the vampire presence suffers damage or terror, the vampire takes a penalty equal to Bane Severity on concentration tests.
Salubri.compulsion: Saviour Complex: overwhelmed by the need to protect the weakest individual in the scene; taking a two dice penalty to any roll that puts that person at risk.

Tzimisce.bane: Haunted Soil: the vampire must sleep surrounded by dirt or memorabilia from their birthplace or grave; sleeping without it causes aggravated willpower damage equal to Bane Severity.
Tzimisce.compulsion: Territorial Possessiveness: compelled to claim ownership of an item or space in the scene; taking a two dice penalty to rolls that do not enforce ownership.
